text: Gimbolt Surehammer was a dwarf, and possible member of the Silver Hand. He traveled to the hut of the witch doctor Zul'ajik, along with his companions the blood elf Maer-thiss, and the goblin Ziggler. They visited the troll in order to hire him to perform a ritual to contact spirits which would lead to the Demonwell. Because of Zul'ajik's hatred for goblins, Ziggler chose to stay outside of the camp and tinker on his clockwork dwarf. While under the influence of blue mushrooms, Ziggler interrupted the ritual when he piloted the clockwork dwarf through the camp and trampled both the troll's tent and Maer-thiss. Gimbolt decided to flee with Ziggler, while Maer-thiss and Zul'ajik decided to kil

Ginduin Lorespeak is a dwarf of Ironforge. He is known for his work; "Being a Recounting of the War of the Three Hammers and History of Dark Iron Dwarves, as Chronicled by Ginduin Lorspeak of Ironforge".

Gimmel was a dwarf who helped Vereesa Windrunner and Falstad Dragonreaver escape the clutches of a band of cannibalistic trolls under the command of Gree. Following their rescue he reported the death of Joj and Narn's injuries to Rom. He was soon revealed to be Rom's second in battle and later in the confidence of Krasus. He didn't like Krasus's decision for the medallion used to speak with him being turned over to Vereesa anymore than chieftain did. He died in the Battle of Grim Batol.
Gladiator's Battlegear is the level 80 warrior arena/PvP gear set. It is composed of any items from these sub-sets:
Gina Gotgoods is a goblin general goods vendor located in Fuselight in the Badlands.
Ging is a warrior trainer at the Crossroads in the Northern Barrens. He fought against demons during the Legion Invasions.
Gina Mudclaw is a pandaren farmer and member of the Tillers, as well as their quartermaster. She is in charge of managing the Halfhill Market.
Gina Gellar is a human stable master found in Nethergarde Keep in the Blasted Lands. It's unknown if she survived the Ironmarch.
Gilneas Refugee is a human located in Rut'theran Village in Teldrassil.
Glacial Eruption is a Frost mage artifact trait. It is linked to the Freezing Rain (artifact trait) and Concordance of the Legionfall traits.
Girrum Highdust is a dwarf located in Bear's Head in Azshara.
Ginger Freelin is a human located at Anglepoint Wharf in Tiragarde Sound.
Giruma Bloodpelt is a Mag'har orc located in Arathi Basin during Brawl: Comp Stomp for Alliance players.
Gina Kingston is a human located at the Stonefield Farm in Elwynn Forest.
Glenda Breezeboot is a Wildhammer dwarf reagents vendor for Kirthaven in the contested territory of the Twilight Highlands.
Gladiator's Resolve is a level 100 warrior talent, added in Warlords of Draenor.
Gladiator Stance is a level 100 warrior talent, added in Warlords of Draenor. It is granted to Protection warriors choosing Gladiator's Resolve.
Glenn Ramtoss is a dwarf found at the central square of Stormshield. He is seen speaking with Cardenaas.
Glark Criswold is a human who appears in Lunarfall when Festive Outfits is purchased during the Feast of Winter Veil.
Glayvianna Soulrender is a night elf located in the Chamber of Night in Vault of the Wardens. She was tempted to betray the Illidari and become Felsworn by Cordana Felsong.
Gleaming Scales is a Protection warrior artifact trait. It is linked to the Bastion of the Aspects and Neltharion's Thunder traits.
Glaive Tempest is a Havoc demon hunter talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Fel Barrage.
Glaure Augurelli is a dragon using the Alchemist's Lab Bench at Algeth'ar Academy in Thaldraszus.
Glensera is a green dragon located next to the Rostrum of Transformation in Valdrakken.
Glorin Steelbrow is a dwarf located in Deepwater Tavern in Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands.

Glodin was a wild dwarf gryphon rider who lost his life defending the port town of Hasic from two dragons. His fellow gryphon riders Molok and Falstad Wildhammer wished his spirit to fight proud through eternity.
Glorenfeld is a dwarf located in Utgarde Catacombs in Howling Fjord.

Glorious Goods is a general goods shop found in the Eventide plaza of Dalaran. Just outside the store is the Dalaran fountain. On its sign there is a raven, indicating the shop is an entrance to the Uncrowned's Hall of Shadows.

Gloria Gahrron was the wife of Del Gahrron while he lived at Gahrron's Quickening, prior to the Scourging of Lordaeron. She was a devout follower of the Light, and used to read from a prayer book every night. Del distinctly remembers her smile from his days at the farm. Gloria's prayer book is still found lying upstairs in the farm house.

Glirin is a Dark Iron dwarf beast master hunter who assisted the champion in harvesting lumber from southern Gorgrond. He can also be seen watching fights between garrison commanders in the Coliseum of Highmaul.
Glugrog is an orc located in Axefall‎ in the Spires of Arak.
Goblin Brawler's Harness is the starting chest for goblin warrior.
Gnaw Bloodseeker is a dire pale orc that ends up attacking Eventide Landing in .

Godric Rothgar is a human armor and shield vendor located in Northshire Valley in Elwynn Forest. He can be found beside a wagon near the entrance of Northshire Abbey. When the Northshire Valley was attacked by the forces of Count Clessington, Godrik remained at his usual spot and was seen fighting two members of the Defias Brotherhood.

Goby Blastenheimer is a gnomish member of the Argent Dawn and was taken prisoner by the Scarlet Crusade in the Scarlet Enclave. When the death knights of Acherus invaded the Enclave, the prisoners traded owners. Gnomish death knights have a chance to execute Blastenheimer.
Goda is a dragon turtle located in Diremoor on the Isle of Thunder.
Gogu is a Mag'har orc located at the orphanage in the Drag of Orgrimmar. He comments on pandaren during The Horde Way. He appears in the Vision of Orgrimmar.
Gokrum Wolfgrinder is an orc located in Mor'gran Logworks in Talador. He is with Steeltusk, a Talador vignette.

Goh'kuu is an orc found in the Sha'tari Market District after the Battle for Shattrath's conclusion, where he is seen kneeling by a wounded Iron Horde orc named Napp'agosh. It is unknown what becomes of both him and Napp'agosh after leads the takeover of .

God-King Skovald was the ruler of the Tideskorn, the vrykul of Stormheim, on the Broken Isles. He allied himself with the Burning Legion during their third invasion of Azeroth, and was tasked by his demonic masters with retrieving the :Aegis of Aggramar, one of the ancient titan relics known as the Pillars of Creation. He was killed by brave order champions within the Halls of Valor during a last-ditch attempt to claim the Aegis.
Goi'orsh is an orc located at The Fel Forge in Tanaan Jungle.
Godrey Redbeard is a dwarf located in Stromgarde Keep in the Arathi Highlands.
Golnir Bouldertoe is a dwarf mining vendor located in the Great Forge in Ironforge. He is somehow related to Geofram Bouldertoe.

Golem Lord Argelmach is a Dark Iron dwarf mini-boss found in Blackrock Depths. Argelmach stands in a private room of the Manufactory, guarded by two elite golems. If threatened, Argelmach will draw all living Manufactory technicians and golems to eliminate adventurers. Before taking him down, adventurers would probably find it advantageous to kill all mobs in the Manufactory first to lessen the difficulty of the fight.
Golorn Frostbeard is a dwarf trade goods vendor located in Kharanos in Dun Morogh. He was present during the Legion Invasions, ready to defend the town with his mace in hand.

Gondria is a rare elite spirit beast found in Zul'Drak. Hunters require the 31 point Exotic Beasts talent in order to tame it. Gondria has the appearance of a spectral saber cat, which was unique until patch 4.2.0.
Goldlilly Gleamingfell is a high elf located under the Violet Hold in the Underbelly. She can provide directions for various locations in the Underbelly.
Goldfury's Hunting Supplies is a hunter shop found in the Military Ward of Ironforge.

Goraluk Anvilcrack is a named Blackrock orc found in Upper Blackrock Spire. His loot has a blacksmithing theme. He sold his soul to the Satyr Lorax, but broke the deal, and ran away with the Unforged Rune Covered Breastplate.
Gorbold Steelhand is a dwarf general trade vendor located at Lor'danel in Darkshore. Before the Cataclysm, he was located in the now ruined town of Auberdine.
Gorg is a mage male ogre magus, and one of the commanders of the Crushridge clan.

Gorgh is an orc warrior. He was Ukk's sergeant. During a fight with some humans he had been injured, a trickle of blood coursing down his scarred face. He also pointed out that their supply wagon had been stolen during the fight, while they had been distracted by target dummies.
Gordun is a dwarf located at Blue Sky Logging Grounds in the Grizzly Hills. He offers a log ride down to Venture Bay for Alliance adventurers.
Gora'tin is a Darkspear jungle troll general goods vendor located at the Darkspear Hold in Durotar.
Gor'in Littlebottom is a dwarf chasing Mr. Stomp around the Wyrmrest Temple base of the Dragon Soul raid.
Gordon Tramsay is a human chef located at the Steam Pools Resort in Feralas.
Gorak is an orc located at the Dread Grotto in Blackrock Foundry.
Gora Layton is a human located at Norwington Estate in Tiragarde Sound.
Gothor Brumn is a dwarf armor vendor located in Algaz Station in Loch Modan.
Gradok is an elite orc encountered on the eastern side of the Loch in Loch Modan. His companions were Haren Swifthoof and Thragomm. They were the equivalent of the Alliance Outrunners in the Barrens.

Gorn One Eye is a furbolg general goods vendor located in Timbermaw Hold in Felwood. Gorn seems to be some kind of a pessimist, as he reacts rudely to adventurers when speaking to him. He also seems untrustworthy of them and won't sell them any of his wares until they're honored with the faction.

Gorkun Ironskull is an orc found in the Pit of Saron of Icecrown Citadel as a slave. After the defeat of Forgemaster Garfrost, he leads the Horde army to fight Scourgelord Tyrannus. After Tyrannus is killed Gorkun begins a speech about his debt to the adventurers who freed him and how nothing can beat the Horde and Alliance when they set aside by their difference only to killed by Sindragosa before he can finish. His Alliance counterpart is Martin Victus.
Gragdin was a dwarf under Rom's command. He was the brother of Griggarth and Grenda. He sacrificed himself to save Grenda in Grim Batol.

Gorka is the leader of the Warsong Labor Camp in Ashenvale. She has players collecting wood and oil before sending them on to Splintertree Post. Following Crisis at Splintertree, Gorka dies after being critically wounded by night elven archers.
Grago is an orc who was caught in by the Emerald Nightmare in Orgrimmar.
Gorx was an orc who killed Allyn and Hoban. Eventually, Rych avenged their death by killing Gorx.
Gormir Stoneshaper is a dwarf located at Starfall Village in Winterspring.
Goro'dan is an orc found in the Siegeworks during the Siege of Orgrimmar.
Gortag Steelgrip is an orc located at the Mok'gol Watchpost in .
Gorma Windspeaker is an orc located in the Heart of Azeroth and the author of the Words of Wind and Earth.
Gorvold Ironbrow was a great vrykul warrior. He was buried on Shield Hill in the Howling Fjord.
Goroth is a pit lord serving as the first boss of the Tomb of Sargeras raid.
Gorrexus is a pit lord located in the Deceiver's Scar in Krokuun.
Gormok Axefall was an orc located at the Mist's Edge in Darkshore.
Gorkak Skullcrusher is a character mentioned on the Chipped Sinstone found in Revendreth.

Grand Admiral is a title given to the commander of a fleet. The Grand Admiral of the Alliance of Lordaeron was Daelin Proudmoore, who was also the Lord Admiral of Kul Tiras. Stormwind's fleet is led by Grand Admiral Jes-Tereth, and the Scarlet Crusade's fleet was led by Grand Admiral Barean Westwind.
Grahm Ciderhammer is a dwarf at Wayward Landing in the Jade Forest.
Gran'dul is an orc warlock trainer located in the Darkfire Enclave in the Cleft of Shadow in Orgrimmar. He was present at the funeral ceremony of Vol'jin in the Dranosh'ar Blockade.
Grand Corruptor U'rogg is an orc located at The Iron Bulwark in .
Grand Lightweaver Doane is a human found outside the wall of Dalaran looking down over the Broken Isles.

Grand Conjurer Mimic is a gnome mage of the Tirisgarde located in the Hall of the Guardian. Mimic can be used to recruit Tirisgarde Apprentices or Kirin Tor Invokers if the advancement Higher Learning is chosen.

Grand Lector Enaara is a Lightforged draenei priest. Despite being a priest, she would gladly go fight and slay demons herself, and in fact, she stated that she would prefer fighting enemies than healing the wounded. When she does heal, she pokes fun of the wounded soldiers of the Army of the Light.
Grand Master Lerah is a human. Lerah's Ribsmasher may be named after her.
Granis Swiftaxe is a dwarf warrior trainer located in Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos in Dun Morogh. He was present during the Legion invasions.

Grawn Thromwyn is a dwarf weapon vendor located in Kharanos in Dun Morogh. He assisted in its defense during the Legion invasions. He also would apply the temporary [http://www.wowhead.com/spell=212272 Gleaming Weaponry] effect for an Alliance player while not busy fighting off demons.
Graud is an orc general goods vendor located in Hammerfall in the Arathi Highlands.
Grawl is an orc general goods vendor located in New Kargath in the Badlands. Before the Cataclysm, he was located in Kargath.
Gratar was an orc who lived on Draenor during the time of the Second War. He possessed black hair and exceptionally strong shoulder muscles.

Grauf is an elite proto-dragon located in Utgarde Pinnacle. Grauf serves as mount to Skadi the Ruthless. Skadi mounts Grauf upon players approaching the duo and proceeds to use his frost breath until brought down by harpoons, which begins the encounter against Skadi. He is originally from the Storm Peaks.
Grapple Weapon is a monk PvP talent, available at level 40 for Brewmaster and Mistweaver, and at level 20 for Windwalker.
Grayson Early is a human found at the Wayward Landing in Jade Forest.
Gravin Steelbeard is a dwarf stable master located at the Farstrider Lodge in Loch Modan.
Grantor is an orc stable master located at Desolation Hold in the Southern Barrens.
Gravewalker Gie is a pandaren death knight located in the Horde commander's garrison of Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern.
Grannok is an orc located at The Iron Front in Tanaan Jungle.
Grayson Bell is a human located in Stromgarde Keep in the Arathi Highlands. He is also at High Perch during the Battle for Stromgarde.
Granny McWeaksauce is a human who provided equipment on the PTR.

Granyth is a Primalist proto-dragon boss in the Nokhud Offensive. He initially circles, unattackable, over the Battle of Spears. In order for him to land and become attackable, players need to kill the Nokhud Lancemasters guarding the three Dragonkiller Lances, which are subsequently also used in the encounter.
Great Reaver Mulga is a Mag'har orc located aboard Orgrim's Hammer in Icecrown. She issues commands to the Kor'kron Reavers and Orgrim's Hammer Shadow-Warders.
Greishan Ironstove is a wandering dwarf bread vendor located on the road between the Valley of Kings and Dun Algaz in Loch Modan.
Green Silk Pack is a 10 slot general-purpose bag made by tailors. Other silk bags include Small Silk Pack and Black Silk Pack.

Grek is an illiterate orc warrior. He can be found in Stonebreaker Hold in Terokkar Forest. Nearby is his trusted wolf mount. You find out that he wants to help his people, but he can't read the nearby wanted poster, when he states: He is approached by Artificer Morphalius who invites him into the Mana-Tombs, but as he is still trying to read the wanted poster, he sends a Horde adventurer to Morphalius instead.

Grekshar was an orc who died prior to Draenor's discovery by the Burning Legion. When Ner'zhul began to suspect that his new patron Kil'jaeden's intentions were less than noble, he visited the ancestors in Oshu'gun. After pleading for the ancestors to guide him, they appeared before Ner'zhul, including Rulkan and Grekshar. They collectively condemned Ner'zhul as being too easily guiled, and too weak to resist the demonlord.

Gree was the leader of a tribe of underground forest trolls. He wore a tattered scarf once owned by an elf. Although they were used by the remaining Horde in Khaz Modan as roaming guards, they would once in awhile capture and eat a single orc if given the chance. He helped capture Vereesa Windrunner and Falstad Dragonreaver, but died in a battle against hill dwarves — the rescuers of Vereesa and Falstad. Vereesa commented that Gree's tribe were the lowest kind of trolls, wandering dark underground tunnels.
Green Dragon Ring is a common night elf archaeology artifact that requires 35 fragments to solve and allows the use of one keystone.

Greenie Girl is a nickname of a guard given by Harrowmeiser, whom she watched over in Westguard Keep in Howling Fjord. She has emerald eyes. When Shokia attacked the keep, she and Bluebell rushed to defend the keep while Zaela and Thalen Songweaver rescued the goblin and his zeppelin, the Lady Lug.
Gregory Adams is a human mage. He wrote a letter to Kirin Tor Monthly, about his friends constantly asking for food, drinks and portals.
Gregas was a human from the who fought with his fellow soldiers in against the invading trolls. He was shot with an arrow.
Gregory Mussler is a human located at Outrigger Post in Tiragarde Sound.
Grekka Anvilsmash is an orc located at the Obsidian Bulwark in the Waking Shores.
Grenil Steelfury is a dwarf weapon vendor located at the Commons in Ironforge.

Grif Wildheart is a dwarf hunter trainer located in Kharanos in Dun Morogh. He teaches new dwarf hunters the important skill of beast taming. Grif used to travel the wilds with his companions Theodore and Huey, occasionally running across a fellow hunter. Grif also appears to know Mimiron.
Gremlock Pilsnor is a dwarf cooking trainer located in Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos in Dun Morogh. He was present during the Legion Invasions.
Gretta Ganter is a dwarf fishing vendor located on Iceflow Lake just outside Brewnall Village in Dun Morogh.
Greshka is an orc warlock located in Stonard in the Swamp of Sorrows.
Greth is an orc stable master located at New Kargath in the Badlands.
Grella is an orc Sha'tari Skyguard reputation rewards vendor located at Blackwind Landing in Terokkar Forest.
Griggarth was a dwarf under Rom's command. He was the brother of Gragdin and Grenda.
Griff is a Dragonmaw clan orc who dwells at Bloodgulch in the Twilight Highlands.
Blixxrak is a dwarf located in Brewnall Village in Dun Morogh. He is a member of the Short & Stout Brewing Co. along with Rana Bubblefizz.
Grendin Swiftaxe is a dwarf warrior trainer located in the town of Thelsamar in Loch Modan. He stands outside a building on the west side of town, next to Morhan Coppertongue the metalsmith.

Grenhild Darktalon is a Wildhammer dwarf shaman trainer located in the town of Thelsamar in Loch Modan. She appears to be an enhancement shaman, as she holds two one-handed maces. She will periodically cast Lightning Shield on herself while idle.

Greyhoof Farwanderer is the apparent leader of the Farwanderers tauren tribe, and an elderly tauren who had served Cairne Bloodhoof faithfully prior to his death. Though he is loyal to his son and successor, Baine, he has become disheartened with Garrosh Hellscream's leadership and considered leading his tribe away from Mulgore, despite Baine's encouragement to remain loyal to their people. Ultimately, Greyhoof decides against this rash course of action after witnessing Baine's victory over the vicious quilboar. He requests a pardon from Baine for doubting his leadership, and Baine gladly grants it.
Grella Stonefist is a Wildhammer dwarf general goods located at the Stormfeather Outpost in the Hinterlands.

Griley is an Alliance soldier who worked with Tarlo Mondan at an unknown point in the past. Griley, Tarlo, and eight others would came across an old dwarven town while in the Wetlands. However Horde had learned of the town as well and established their own camp. In order to eliminate the Horde forces present, Griley came up with an idea to grab anything of value and then blow it up when the orcs approached. The orcs being suspicious, sent in goblins to check things out and when they dug deep enough Griley blew the goblins up. With the orcs distracted Griley, Tarlo, and the others tossed their ropes over the west gate and sneaked out. His current whereabouts are unknown.
Grelwaz Redknife is an orc follower located at Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern.
Greydon Thorne is a human sailor from Stormwind, and the Captain of the Wavestrider.
Griffith Shelvey is a human located at the Fallhaven in Drustvar. He owned Betsy.
Griddon is a human located in the Longdrop Hot Springs in Tiragarde Sound.
Grelka is an orc located in Ar'gorok in the Arathi Highlands during the Battle for Stromgarde.

Greta Albrite is a human located in the Arathi Highlands. She can be found in a small house, dancing with (presumed husband) Nordric Albrite. If Arathi is controlled by the Horde and Horde adventurers confront them, she will cower behind Nordic.
Grezla Bloodfury is an orc warrior located in the Arathi Highlands during the Battle for Stromgarde. She appears in both versions.
Grevigos was a blue dragon who was killed by Neltharion's betrayal during the War of the Ancients. His name is on a Crumbling Gravestone at the Veiled Ossuary.
Greta Herzig is a dwarf located in the Ruins of Drekazera in Zaralek Cavern.
Grimtak is an orc meat and drink vendor located west of the inn in Razor Hill in Durotar. He lost one of his fingers during cooking some meal.

Grimbooze Thunderbrew is a dwarf located in the Dagger Hills in Westfall. A jovial brewer, he liked to give clues to his original quests by speaking in rhymes. He later joined Hemet Nesingwary's expedition to Sholazar Basin in Northrend, in search of a new brew.
Grimnal is an orc mail and plate armor vendor located in Stonard in the Swamp of Sorrows.

Grimm Onearm is a goblin techno mage. The ".3" of the cabal, Grimm is a goblin who lost his right arm and leg in a rather impressive accident. He has prosthetic limbs that are made from metal, look exactly like flesh, and respond to his mind’s commands. Few other than other techno mages realize his limbs are not natural. Although he jokes he is only .3 of a member of the cabal, he still carries a lot of weight in the House of the Arcane Contraption. When not sailing his merchant ship up and down the coast, secretly smuggling Horde supplies to roguish Alliance groups who care not for the affiliation enmity and only want the goods, he spends his time at the House of the Arcane Contraption, tra
Grimthorn Redbeard is a dwarf present on the Timeless Isle at Celestial Tournament.

Grimnir Sternhammer is a dwarf of the Explorer's League found in Stormshield Stronghold in Ashran. He can be found talking to Misirin Stouttoe. During the Burning Legion's third invasion, he was seen above Felsoul Hold in Suramar with Briann Highfall.
Grinning Tolg is a Laughing Skull orc that was turned into an Infested.
Grimroz Darkwhisper is a Mag'har orc located in Shadowdeep Reagents in the Cleft of Shadow in Orgrimmar. He appears to be preparing a potion. His attire marks him a member of the .

Captain Grizzgear was a zeppelin captain and a friend of the gladiator master Sparkeye. He and his zeppelin brought Rehgar Earthfury and his gladiator team—consisting of Lo'Gosh, Broll Bearmantle and Valeera Sanguinar—to Dire Maul and later to Thunder Bluff.
Groll is an orc general goods vendor located at Warsong Hold in the Borean Tundra. Take the elevator all the way down, he's behind the ramp to the right.

Grom-Grom is an orc mentioned by members of the Twilight's Hammer in the Twilight Bulwark. No one has seen him for a while, and some speculate that he went AWOL. However his corpse can be seen a short distance away from Lakota Windsong at the foot of the base.
Grizz is a Dragonmaw orc located at the Dragonmaw Port in the Twilight Highlands.
Grit is a goblin and part of the Gob Squad, he is seen in Azshara and the Twilight Highlands. He is also present in the Secrets of Ragefire and in Nazmir.

Grom'gar is the ancestral home of the orc clan located in Frostfire Ridge. According to legend, Grom'gar was built in the skeletal remains of the last colossal, which was supposedly killed by the Thunderlords many generations ago. After the Thunderlords attacked the Frostwolf clan, the Frostwolf orcs retaliated with the help of the Horde and invaded Grom'gar. The attack led to the death of the Thunderlord chieftain, Fenris.

Gronnstalker Rokash is a former member of the and a potential follower. He sends the Horde commander on a quest to demonstrate that the Thunderlords are a clan on the brink of losing. He appears to hold a personal grudge against the target of his task. He can also be seen watching fights between garrison commanders in the Coliseum of Highmaul.
Gronnslaver Raz is an orc found at Crushfang's End in Gorgrond.
Grok Stonecaller is an orc located in Warspear. He is speaking with Jennifer Szmurlo.
Gro'thogg is an orc located at Andorhal in The Deaths of Chromie scenario.

Grol Warblade is an orc located in Southwind Village in Silithus: The Wound. He was dealing with the silithid reports and had Horde adventurers motivate lazy prospectors. He also demanded the head of Michiel Voidstrider in order to end the Twilight's Hammer cult in Silithus. Although Michiel was killed and Grol ordered raids on the Twilight Outpost‎, it didn't have the effect the orc commander hoped, and he couldn't put an end to the outpost, which is still active after the Fourth War.

Grizzled Jopp is a one-eyed ecstatic human under the command of Prince Galen Trollbane and is one of the defenders of Stromgarde. He participated in the Second War and at some point fought alongside Brann Bronzebeard but the later doesn't remember him. When Brann was in Stromgarde, Grizzle broke into his personal ale supply and they drank themselves silly one night.
Grok Seahandler is an orc located at Seawatch Point in Stormsong Valley. He offers transportation back to the Port of Zandalar for Horde players.

Grok Thickfoot is an orc located at Dranosh'ar Blockade in Durotar. He is also found at the Life Vault Ruins in the Waking Shores and Emberwatch in the Ohn'ahran Plains, speaking with a Rugged Artisan.
Grum Redbeard is a dwarf located in the Starfall Village barrow den in Winterspring.

Gruham Rumdnul is a dwarf general goods vendor located in Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands. He appears to be the husband of Derina Rumdnul and the father of Gimlok Rumdnul, the only known male dwarf child in the game.
Gruklash is a rare orc located in front of Blackrock Stronghold in the Burning Steppes.
Gruna is an orc bread and drink vendor located at Flame Crest in the Burning Steppes.
Grumbol Stoutpick is a Wildhammer dwarf grand master mining trainer located at Valgarde in the contested territory of the Howling Fjord.

Grunn'Holde was an orc member of the Argent Dawn. She initially derided Darion Mograine's attempt to storm Naxxramas, asking why he would charge blindly into almost certain death to rescue his dead father. She reconsidered when Darion responded with "because he's my father", stating that orcs put great pride in their lineages as well. After putting an axe into Lady Blaumeux's head, she was slain when Alexandros Mograine plunged the Ashbringer into her back.
Grunt Ragefist is an orc located at northern Steeljaw's Caravan in the Borean Tundra.
Gruk is an orc child found in eastern part of Northern Barrens near the road to Ratchet. He'll sometimes bring Guard Taruc food.
Grunt Kor'ja is an orc grunt located near the entrance to Razor Hill in Durotar. She has been wounded defending the town from remnant soldiers from Tiragarde Keep.
Grunt Bek'rah is an orc located in the Hall of Legends in Orgrimmar.

Grot Deathblow is an orc quartermaster for Dragonmaw Clan found in Bloodgulch of the Twilight Highlands. Grot was present at the first Azerothian Kosh'harg in Razor Hill in Durotar. He was accompanied by Herezegor Flametusk.
Grotz was an orc warrior who helped escort carts loaded with supplies of water for the Horde in Mulgore. He was slain by a group of quilboar along with Izwix and Dras.
Groundskeeper Chu is a pandaren member of the Golden Lotus, located at Mistfall Village in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

Marshal Gryan Stoutmantle is a human paladin located at Sentinel Hill, in Westfall. He is a paladin of the Order of the Silver Hand and the leader of the Westfall Brigade, formerly the People's Militia. As a marshal of the Kingdom of Stormwind, he is the ruler and law enforcer of Westfall, leading the Brigade's efforts to restore the region to its former glory. He is notably the one who organized the resistance against the Defias Brotherhood, putting an end to their actions and crimes by calling on Alliance heroes to eliminate their leader Edwin VanCleef. During the Scourgewar, he led the Westfall Brigade as their captain in the Grizzly Hills, where they supported the Alliance advance in Nor
Grumpherys is a dwarf hunter who appears in and is frequently referenced by the World of Warcraft Trading Card Game.
Grum Boarsbane is a dwarf located at Lunarfall in . He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.
Grun'lek is an orc located at the War Mill in Frostwall. He sells transmogrification sets. On level 3, he grants one free Seal of Tempered Fate.
Grove Druid is a night elf druid located at the Greenwarden's Grove in the Wetlands.
Grumble is a dwarf located in Stromgarde Keep in the Arathi Highlands.
Groundskeeper Olivia is a human located in Trollbane Hall in Arathi Basin.
Growing Inferno is a conduit for demon hunters. It drops from Surgeon Stitchflesh in the Necrotic Wake and Sylvanas Windrunner in the Sanctum of Domination.
Grun Ashbeard is a dwarf located at Wingrest Embassy in the Waking Shores. He is found in front of a Cracked Elemental.

Guard Taruc is an orc found in eastern part of Northern Barrens near the road to Ratchet. He can sometimes be found inside the cook's hut eating food brought by Gruk. Taruc stood guard at Gruk's during the Legion Invasions. Duhng, Tarban Hearthgrain and Grub were all cowering in fear behind him.
Guard Roberts is a human guard found near the lake east of Goldshire in the Elwynn Forest. He has been injured for the past several years.
Guard Captain Zorek is a human located in Valgarde in the Howling Fjord.
Guard Mitchells is a human guarding the prison of Valiance Keep in the Borean Tundra. He is secretly a member of the Cult of the Damned.

Guard Captain Cragtar is an orc captain found standing in the middle of Thrallmar in the Hellfire Peninsula by the bonfire watching over the 4 injured grunts. Like the other orcs first arriving in Outland he had no idea how there were still fel orcs present and lost some of his best soldiers from a fel orc assault.

Guardian Spirit is a Holy priest talent. It causes a friendly target to receive 40% increased healing for 10 seconds. If the target dies while under the effect of the spell, the Guardian Spirit will prevent death by sacrificing itself and restore 40% of the target's maximum health - massive amounts of damage will however not trigger this effect. Guardian Spirit can be cast while stunned.

Guard Kurall is an orc found at the watch tower north of the Crossroads, in the Northern Barrens. Erk brings him and the other guards fish from the nearby lake. During the Legion Invasions, he stood guard at the tower, slashing the enemies.

Guardian Menerin is a blood elf found within the stronghold of Kargathia Keep in Ashenvale. He was the guardian of Envoy Sheelah, sent as an ambassador to the Warsong Clan, though Sheelah was killed by a night elf assassin. Menerin blames himself for not being able to protect her.

Guard Jarad is a human located on Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh. He fought for the Red Team. It's unknown if he survived the Attack on Theramore Isle, but as a soldier, he was likely killed in combat or from the bomb.

Guard Tark is a human located on Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh. He fought for the Red Team. It's unknown if he survived the Attack on Theramore Isle, but as a soldier, he was likely killed in combat or from the bomb.

Guard Lana is a human located on Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh. She fought for the Red Team. It's unknown if she survived the Attack on Theramore Isle, but as a soldier, she was likely killed in combat or from the bomb.

Guard Edward is a human located on Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh. He fought for the Blue Team. It's unknown if he survived the Attack on Theramore Isle, but as a soldier, he was likely killed in combat or from the bomb.

Guard Kahil is a human located on Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh. He fought for the Blue Team. It's unknown if he survived the Attack on Theramore Isle, but as a soldier, he was likely killed in combat or from the bomb.

Guard Narrisha is a human located on Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh. She fought for the Blue Team. It's unknown if she survived the Attack on Theramore Isle, but as a soldier, she was likely killed in combat or from the bomb.

Guard Lasiter is a human located on Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh. He is constantly practicing his archery skills. It's unknown if he survived the Attack on Theramore Isle, but as a soldier, he was likely killed in combat or from the bomb.
Gryphoneer Leafbeard is a Wildhammer dwarf located in the Hellfire Peninsula.
Guard Captain Thag is the ogre captain of the King's Guard, located at the Throne of the Imperator in Highmaul.
Guardian Angel is a Holy priest talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Guardians of the Light.
Guardian Jin Sulerion is a blood elf located in Deliverance Point on the Broken Shore.
Guardsman Hayles is a human located in Arom's Stand in Drustvar.
Guardian Alar is a high elf located in Hall of the Guardian. She recruits Kirin Tor Guardians.
Guard-Commander Trunksal is a human located in Tiragarde Sound.
Guard Captain Atu is a skeletal troll guard captain located in Kings' Rest.
Guardsman Taylor is a human located in Mezzamere in Nazjatar.

Gunder Thornbush is a human trade goods vendor located in the Scarlet Raven Tavern in Darkshire, in the human-aligned territory of Duskwood. During the third invasion of the Burning Legion, Gunder was killed by the fanatical Night Watchers who joined the Veiled Hand cult.
Gunda Boldhammer is a dwarf and the innkeeper for Frosthold in the Storm Peaks.
Gunra is an orc Justice Points vendor found on the upper level of Grommash Hold from the back in Orgrimmar.
Gunwald Greybeard is a Wildhammer dwarf who patrols the Thundermar Ruins in the Twilight Highlands.
Gul'rok is a large orc village found in southwestern Talador where the is preparing for another assault on .
Gumrot is an orc located at the Rangari Refuge in Tanaan Jungle.

Gurlak was a proud loyal orc warrior of the Frostwolf clan, who greatly respected Durotan. When Nokrar abandoned the Frostwolves in an attempt to join the Horde, Gurlak would join Durotan's party in hunting them down and along with the others would be horrified to discover Nokrar dead and eaten. Unwilling to let Nokrar's children suffer the same fate the Frostwolves would find and attack the nearby Redwalkers and Gurlak would die in the fighting. Durotan would note that Gurlak, who loved to sing lok'vadnods, would have been pleased that he had earned one.

Gunner Pops is a gnomish member of the "Bloodsail Boomers" who appears at the Bloodsail Buccaneers' beach party on the Cape of Stranglethorn's Wild Shore during Pirates' Day. He will occasionally burst into song alongside the other Bloodsail Boomers - Cook Lastwind, First Mate Nereus, and Quartermaster Rowley.

Gurr Firecaller was an ogre located in Bloodmaul Slag Mines where he took over a portion of the mines containing a shipment of valuable fuel. He was taken out by the followers sent from the garrisons.
Gunner Erikson is a member of the Ashvane Trading Company standing under a pavilion in the western part of the Ashvane Encampment in Vol'dun.

Gunk is an orcish boy and Thrall's page after his previous page, Zekhan, was elevated to the position of ambassador to Zuldazar. After receiving word that Tyrande would meet with him at Nordrassil, Thrall sent Gunk to inform Baine Bloodhoof and Calia Menethil in Grommash Hold.
Gunner Pirian is a human located by the river at Thunderspine Thicket and in the eastern river in the Ohn'ahran Plains.
Gwenna Firebrew is a dwarf drink vendor located in the Commons in Ironforge.
Gwina Stonebranch is a dwarf herbalism vendor located at the Great Forge within Ironforge.
Guzul'dar is a jungle troll shadow hunter and witch doctor. He is a companion of Lenaeas, Stefon the Loyal, and Tagradin.
Gwendolyn is a dwarf located in the Explorers' League in Explorers' League Outpost in Howling Fjord.
Gymer is the ruler of Northrend's storm giants. He was lured into a trap by his now undead brother, Thiassi the Lightning Bringer, and is a prisoner of the Scourge.

H'jalla Danfour was a human warrior in the service of the Horde. Her orc masters had hired her to find and kill the traitor known as Hellak Darkhorn, who had aligned himself with the Alliance. She completed her mission easily, because Hellak thought she was a member of the Alliance, like himself.
Gurrok is an orc survivor first found in an underwater cavern in Kelp'thar Forest. His counterpart is Private Pollard.
Gutcheck is an orc vendor found at Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands.
Gurt is an orc weapon vendor located at the Menders' Stead in the Western Plaguelands.
Gustav Pinson is a level 90 human found wandering Lunarfall.
Gwinolen Stormgrip is a dwarf located at Lunarfall in . She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.
Guy Fireeye is a blood elf cooking trainer found in Warspear on Ashran. He is located downstairs in the Brokenspear Tavern.

Haardgrim is a vrykul located on the Broken Shore, where he fell in battle. The golden Val'kyr Danica the Reclaimer deemed his and Alrik's souls worthy and brought them to the Halls of Valor to become part of the Valarjar.
Gyrdaen Windreef is a night elf located in the Gloaming Reef in Val'sharah.
Gwyndra Wildhammer is a Wildhammer dwarf located in the Arathi Highlands during the Battle for Stromgarde, appearing in both versions.
Haalie Millionia is a void elf located in Mezzamere in Nazjatar.

H'partho Ardoros is a draenei member of the Explorer's League. He can be found in several locations across the zone. He is present at the Maker's Ascent in Uldum during the Assault in Uldum along with several other members of the league, the Ruins of Ammon with a number of Wastewander warriors, and Ramkahen. He has friends in the Golden Lotus. He assists with tending to the Voidtouched Egg and raising it to a Shadowbarb Hatchling and eventually to a Shadowbarb Drone.
Hal McAllister is a human fish vendor located in Southshore in the Hillsbrad Foothills. With the destruction of Southshore by Forsaken plague bombing in Cataclysm, Hal's fate is unclear.

Halis Dawnstrider is a blood elf general goods vendor located outside of the inn at Fairbreeze Village in Eversong Woods. He is the only source for Bundle of Fireworks, needed for The Party Never Ends. Occasionally Halis will try to get Magistrix Landra Dawnstrider's attention and will sigh when unable to. It is unknown whether the two are blood relatives or married.
Halazzi is the Amani lord of lynxes. He is one of the four animal bosses in the Zul'Aman instance. He guards the cage containing the gnome female Ashli who is part of the Zul'Aman Timed Event.
Hadrius Harlowe is a human stable master found in Nesingwary Base Camp in Sholazar Basin.
Halga Steelbarrow is a dwarf warrior who wanders around Dalaran and acts like a player (using Hearthstone, training professions, checking the bank, etc.).
Hagatha Moorehead is a human reagent vendor found inside Sisters Sorcerous in Dalaran. During the purge of Dalaran, she was conjuring fire.
Halbin Frosthammer is a Wildhammer dwarf shaman trainer located in Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos in Dun Morogh. He defended the town during the Legion Invasions. He summoned his totems.
Hajukka is a male jungle troll barbarian and a commander of the Bloodscalp tribe.

Haggis Boatmurder is a dwarf found inside Bael Modan Keep at Bael Modan in the Southern Barrens. He sometimes guards the Bael'Dun Fortress Schematics. It is unknown if he survived the destruction of the keep.

Inquisitor Halbin was a member of the Scarlet Crusade. His discipline and calculated focus were unmatched among the members of the crusade, which gave him the greatest chance of successfully wielding the staff called :Light's Wrath. In the Scarlet Monastery, Halbin used the staff to torture Forsaken prisoners, searing them with holy fire to extract information for the crusade to use in its war against the undead. The more Halbin interacted with the Forsaken, the more he grew to loathe them, and as time went on he no longer cared about gathering intelligence from them. Instead, he simply wanted to hear their screams. During one night of torture, his anger overwhelmed his thoughts, and for onl
Hagras Wartaker is an orc located in Southwind Village in Silithus: The Wound.
Hagrin Firebones is a Dark Iron dwarf. He was to be involved with Yrel.
Hadexian is a black dragon located at the Seat of the Aspects in Valdrakken.
Hadexia was a black dragon planned to appear in Zaralek Cavern.
Hadwin is a Kul Tiran human paladin located in Brackenhide Hollow in the Azure Span and in Thaldraszus.

Hamuul Runetotem is the Archdruid of Thunder Bluff and a venerated leader of the tauren people. Taught by Malfurion Stormrage himself, he is the highest-ranked tauren in the Cenarion Circle. As many of his people do, Hamuul believes very much in the balance between nature and the races of Azeroth. Hamuul was a childhood friend and fierce supporter of High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof, and teaches the ways of druidism to his honored brethren. After Cairne was murdered by Magatha Grimtotem, Hamuul continued his role as advisor to Cairne's son Baine, the new High Chieftain, as well as teaching young druids. As one of Azeroth's most venerable druids, Hamuul has aided in the defense of the world on
Hammon Karwn is a human trade goods vendor located in Refuge Pointe in the Arathi Highlands.

Halmish is a wild gray-haired old man, who is bent over so that he is almost as tall as a dwarf. He moves with a quickness and fluidity that belies his ancient frame. He lives southeast of Silverpine Forest in Hillsbrad Foothills in a small cabin. He gives out warnings to those who try to enter into the Silverpine Forest. His descriptions of the forest are very accurate. He once warned Brann Bronzebeard about the dangers in the forest, but it only piqued Brann's interest.
Hammelhand is a Wildhammer dwarf found in the eastern Twilight Highlands.
